'''Ministry of Data and Statistics''' ('''KOSTAT'''; {{Korean|hangul=국가데이터처}}) is a government organization responsible for managing [[Official statistics|national statistics]] in [[South Korea]]. KOSTAT is headquartered in [[Daejeon]], South Korea and operates under the [[Ministry of Economy and Finance (South Korea)|Ministry of Economy and Finance]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://unstats.un.org/unsd/dnss/docViewer.aspx?docID=2605 |title=Overview of KOSTAT |author=<!--Not stated--> |date= |website= |publisher=[[United Nations Statistics Division]] |access-date= |quote=}}</ref>

The Ministry of Data and Statistics generates population and household [[census]] yearly (every 5 years until 2015).<ref>{{Cite news |url=https://www.hani.co.kr/arti/economy/economy_general/836769.html |title=인구조사가 5년 주기에서 1년으로 바뀐 까닭은 |last=Heo |first=Seung |date=2018-03-19 |access-date=2018-04-14 |language=Korean}}</ref> It also gathers analytic and administrative statistics.<ref>{{citation |url=https://guides.library.duke.edu/koreanstudies/eresources_general |title=E-resources: Online Resources - General |work= Research Guide: Korean Studies |publisher=[[Duke University Libraries]] |location=US |archiveurl=https://perma.cc/55ND-JKEX |archivedate= 23 July 2019 }}</ref>

Originally named Statistics Korea, the [[Lee Jae-myung government]] elevated the  organization to the ministerial level on October 1, 2025, renaming it to the Ministry of Data and Statistics.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://mods.go.kr/board.es?mid=a20401000000&bid=11777&act=view&list_no=438854&tag=&nPage=1&ref_bid=|title=Statistics Korea has been reorganized as the Ministry of Data and Statistics.|date=30 September 2025|access-date=29 January 2026|url-status=live|work=Ministry of Data and Statistics News}}</ref>
